description: Return what is left on a closed-loop token issued by a business through Orbylon: a gift card, prepaid hours, a membership or a points balance. Takes the code printed on the card. These are not money and cannot be cashed out or transferred: they are only good with the business that issued them, which is named in the answer.

code.description: The code on the card, e.g. ABCD-2345-PQRS

name: check_business_token
title: Check a gift card, pass or membership
